current_path.reason: The Semantic guest buffers each transferred asset as a complete Vec<u8>. tract-onnx external tensor resolution canonicalizes filesystem paths, while model_for_read supplies no model path. Its external-data resolver returns a Vec per tensor and Tensor::from_raw copies that buffer into aligned tensor storage.

bounded_streaming_design.method: Host streams each signed external-data range into an owned per-initializer Vec. A custom tract ModelDataResolver moves each Vec into tract's buffer, avoiding an additional whole-file copy. Tensor::from_raw then makes one final aligned tensor copy and the consumed input Vec is dropped. The largest initializer is first in graph order; subsequent tensors are at most 33,562,624 bytes.
bounded_streaming_design.estimated_peak_formula: sum of graph-declared external tensor ranges (2,271,023,104) + largest active raw-to-tensor copy (1,024,008,192)
required_changes: Add an isolated reranker inference component API that enumerates validated tensor ranges, receives one tensor at a time, and moves its Vec into tract during parse.
Use existing workspace.asset.read ranges from the outer Semantic guest; do not add a generic Host/WIT operation.
Add a minimal wasm-only external path resolution patch for tract-onnx while preserving its relative-path validation and the existing non-wasm resolver.
Decode the pinned graph protobuf and call the public Onnx::parse API with a custom provider; model_for_read is unsuitable because it passes no external-data path.
Profile optimization and inference peak memory and confirm BGE operator/tokenizer compatibility before declaring the feature available.
bounded_streaming_design.known_memory_sharing: tract InferenceFact concrete values and TypedModel constants use Arc<Tensor>, so infer-to-typed translation shares base tensor storage. Optimizer-created transformed constants and real inference buffers have not been measured.
bounded_streaming_design.device_claim: No browser or mobile peak measurement has been performed. The estimate is a linear-memory allocation model, not a device capability result. Unsupported devices must keep reranking unavailable.

product_identity_policy: Do not replace this fp32 artifact with quantized or differently sourced weights without an explicit product decision and a new quality/corpus acceptance gate.
